info.name: AFRY Toll Fee Calculator (2013) Test
info.description: Start the API first: `dotnet run --project src/TollFeeCalculator.Api`. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to the URL printed at startup. Run everything with Collection Runner; each request has tests asserting the expected fee.
